references.text: Moses repeats the command that the armed men from the tribes east of the Jordan must cross over and help their brothers take possession of the land.
Joshua reminds Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh of Moses' command that their warriors must go armed ahead of their brothers.
Fulfillment of the command: The men of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh crossed the Jordan armed in front of the Israelites.
Background to the command: Reuben and Gad ask to receive the land east of the Jordan as their inheritance.
Context for the command: The distribution of the land east of the Jordan to Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
Joshua sends the tribes east of the Jordan home after they have fulfilled the command and helped their brothers take possession of the land.
